author: Aydran
body:
Hey guys!
Well I was in the game committee notes section and found that on our last meeting we accepted 7 gamemodes which was the final list that was going to be sent to funky but apparently FTW never got a response......................

But anyways here are the 7 gamemodes:
Apocalypse 
Assault 
Boat battles 
Capture The Beacon ← Yayyy :D
Wolves vs Rabbits - A custom version of Wolves vs Pigs that we came up. I will post some info about it here tomorrow.
Freeze-ish tag
Miscount  

- Adrian <3
